original_record.text_en: How did holiday and non-holiday average daily sales each grow this year versus last year?
original_record.text_zh: 今年节假日和平日的日均销售额，各比去年增长了百分之多少？

refs.interpretation: 遵守企业约定及题干限定口径
refs.sql:
WITH daily AS (
SELECT d.DateKey AS day,d.IsHoliday AS holiday,toYear(d.DateKey) AS y,sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
FROM retail.DimDate d LEFT JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales f ON d.DateKey=f.DateKey
WHERE toYear(d.DateKey) IN (2008,2009) GROUP BY day,holiday,y)
SELECT holiday,(avgIf(day_sales,y=2009)/nullIf(avgIf(day_sales,y=2008),0)-1)*100 AS daily_sales_growth_pct
FROM daily GROUP BY holiday

refs.interpretation: 遵守企业约定及题干限定口径
refs.sql:
WITH actual AS (SELECT StoreKey,sum(SalesAmount) AS sales_amount FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY StoreKey),
targets AS (SELECT StoreKey,sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota_amount FROM retail.FactSalesQuota WHERE ScenarioKey=2 AND toYear(DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY StoreKey),
gaps AS (SELECT s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,s.EmployeeKey AS EmployeeKey,if(e.EmployeeKey=0,NULL,concat(e.FirstName,' ',e.LastName)) AS manager,
t.quota_amount-a.sales_amount AS gap FROM retail.DimStore s LEFT JOIN actual a ON s.StoreKey=a.StoreKey
LEFT JOIN targets t ON s.StoreKey=t.StoreKey LEFT JOIN retail.DimEmployee e ON s.EmployeeKey=e.EmployeeKey)
SELECT EmployeeKey,manager,countIf(gap>0) AS under_target_stores,sumIf(gap,gap>0) AS shortfall_amount
FROM gaps GROUP BY EmployeeKey,manager

original_record.text_zh: 2009年各门店有哪些连续至少3个月未完成销售目标的时段？列出起止月份和连续月数。

refs.interpretation: 遵守企业约定及题干限定口径
refs.sql:
WITH actual AS (SELECT StoreKey,toMonth(DateKey) AS m,sum(SalesAmount) AS sales_amount FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY StoreKey,m),
targets AS (SELECT StoreKey,toMonth(DateKey) AS m,sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota_amount FROM retail.FactSalesQuota WHERE ScenarioKey=2 AND toYear(DateKey)=2009 GROUP BY StoreKey,m),
monthly AS (SELECT s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,s.StoreName AS StoreName,toUInt8(n.number+1) AS m,a.sales_amount AS sales_amount,t.quota_amount AS quota_amount
FROM retail.DimStore s CROSS JOIN numbers(12) n LEFT JOIN actual a ON s.StoreKey=a.StoreKey AND n.number+1=a.m
LEFT JOIN targets t ON s.StoreKey=t.StoreKey AND n.number+1=t.m),
under AS (SELECT StoreKey,StoreName,m,toInt64(m)-toInt64(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY m)) AS island
FROM monthly WHERE sales_amount<quota_amount)
SELECT StoreName,min(m) AS start_month,max(m) AS end_month,count() AS months
FROM under GROUP BY StoreKey,StoreName,island HAVING months>=3

records.original_question: 按首购月份比较，客户在首购后90天内的复购率分别是多少？

original_record.text_en: What was the 90-day repurchase rate by lifetime first-purchase month?
original_record.text_zh: 按首购月份比较，客户在首购后90天内的复购率分别是多少？

refs.interpretation: 首购日后第1至90天，出现订单即复购；完整随访；购买事件=全部行
refs.sql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey
HAVING addDays(first_date,90)<=toDate('2009-12-31')),
observed AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,c.first_date AS first_date,countDistinctIf(f.SalesOrderNumber,f.DateKey>c.first_date AND f.DateKey<=addDays(c.first_date,90)) AS purchases
FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales f ON c.CustomerKey=f.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.first_date)
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_date) AS cohort_month,countIf(purchases>0)*100.0/count() AS repurchase_pct FROM observed GROUP BY cohort_month

refs.interpretation: 首购日计入90日窗；去重订单数至少2才复购；完整随访；购买事件=全部行
refs.sql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey
HAVING addDays(first_date,89)<=toDate('2009-12-31')),
observed AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,c.first_date AS first_date,countDistinctIf(f.SalesOrderNumber,f.DateKey>=c.first_date AND f.DateKey<=addDays(c.first_date,89)) AS purchases
FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales f ON c.CustomerKey=f.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.first_date)
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_date) AS cohort_month,countIf(purchases>1)*100.0/count() AS repurchase_pct FROM observed GROUP BY cohort_month

refs.interpretation: 首购日后第1至90天，出现订单即复购；完整随访；购买事件=SalesQuantity>0；亦覆盖：首购日计入90日窗；去重订单数至少2才复购；完整随访（正销量结果相同）
refs.sql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM (SELECT * FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE SalesQuantity>0) GROUP BY CustomerKey
HAVING addDays(first_date,90)<=toDate('2009-12-31')),
observed AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,c.first_date AS first_date,countDistinctIf(f.SalesOrderNumber,f.DateKey>c.first_date AND f.DateKey<=addDays(c.first_date,90)) AS purchases
FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE SalesQuantity>0) f ON c.CustomerKey=f.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.first_date)
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_date) AS cohort_month,countIf(purchases>0)*100.0/count() AS repurchase_pct FROM observed GROUP BY cohort_month
